svg.title: Three aggregations, one 360 view
svg.desc: An infographic. Above, the views nest: the customer's composed 360 view (level 3) contains the vendor's (level 2), which contains Patternode's facets (level 1); beside it, the inverter's 360 view as the customer sees it, each row labelled C, V or P for who keeps it. Below, where the data lives: the utility's tenancy, the vendor's zone for the utility, and the root tenancy, joined by entity links (same-as, is-a, located-at), with the vendor sharing its zone's facets with the utility, and common and cohort data reaching each party by its own entitlement, never re-shared. A strip at the foot shows the same pattern for a financial institution.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A customer (a utility or a financial institution), its vendor and Patternode each keep facets about the same asset. Each view adds its own facets to the one inside it, by key, without copies.
